title: Most frequent words
prompt: Read from standard input: a first line with a number K (a positive integer), then free text on the remaining lines. A word is a maximal run of ASCII letters; everything else (digits, punctuation, spaces, apostrophes, hyphens) separates words. Words are compared ignoring case and printed in lowercase. Print the K most frequent words, one per line as `word count`, ordered by count (highest first) and, for equal counts, alphabetically. If the text has fewer than K different words, print all of them. If the text has no word print `no words`.

The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.
The dog barks; the fox runs away. Quick, quick!
